commit.message:
fix(schedule): fall back to EarlyStart/EarlyFinish for task windows (#6803) (#6805)

* fix(schedule): fall back to EarlyStart/EarlyFinish for task windows (#6803)

A task whose IfcTaskTime carries only CPM dates (EarlyStart/EarlyFinish,
ScheduleStart/ScheduleFinish `$`) got no Gantt bar, no 4D window and was
'unscheduled' in charts. buildingSMART's construction-scheduling sample
writes every leaf task this way.

One resolver (store/slices/schedule-task-dates.ts) now serves the Gantt
range/bars, the 4D animator, the charts dataset, the Properties schedule
card, bar drag, add-task anchoring and the milestone toggle, replacing
three diverged copies (the animator ignored start + duration; charts
parsed TZ-less IfcDateTime as local time). Early dates are used only
when no planned or actual date exists, so such files resolve as before.

* test(schedule): drive the early-window animator test through IfcRelAssignsToProduct outputs (#6803)

* fix(schedule): seed early dates as planned on first edit; editor and task tree read the resolver (#6803)

* fix(schedule): calendar-correct month/year durations, card dates parsed like the Gantt, cover date writes (#6803)

---------

Co-authored-by: Louis True <louistrue@users.noreply.github.com>

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"@ifc-lite/viewer": patch
+---
+
+Fall back to `EarlyStart`/`EarlyFinish` for a task's window when its IfcTaskTime has no planned or actual date (#6803). buildingSMART's construction-scheduling sample writes leaf tasks this way, and those tasks used to get no Gantt bar or 4D window. The Gantt, schedule range, 4D animator, charts, Properties schedule card, bar drag and add-task anchoring now all resolve the window through one resolver. This removes the old copies that had diverged: the animator ignored start + duration, and the charts parsed TZ-less dates as local time. Files that carry planned or actual dates resolve exactly as before. A task with a start and a duration but no finish now gets a derived finish in the 4D animation and charts, matching its Gantt bar. TaskEditCard shows the resolved window. The first planned edit to an early-only task copies its early dates into the planned fields, so editing a single field no longer removes the bar. Whole months and years in a start-anchored duration are now added as calendar months, clamped to month end, as IfcDuration specifies: 2024-01-01 + P1M ends on 2024-02-01, not after a 30.44-day average. The Properties schedule card parses dates the way the Gantt does, so the two show the same day.
